resources.label: Presentation Prompt — Without the Skill
resources.instruction: Go back to the chat where you answered the 5 mission questions. Do not start a new chat — every finding your Minion uncovered is already in that conversation. Run this and keep the result.
resources.content: Build a presentation for Gru covering everything we found today.
resources.note: Notice what it did NOT do. It never asked who is in the room, what you want Gru to decide, or what tone fits. It just started building.

resources.label: Presentation Builder Skill
resources.description: A Skill that makes Claude interview you first, then build a properly designed deck and hand it back as a PowerPoint file. Works in any Project, on any topic.

resources.label: Presentation Prompt — With the Skill
resources.instruction: Stay in that same chat. Paste the identical prompt again, word for word. Change nothing — the only thing different this time is that the Skill exists.
resources.content: Build a presentation for Gru covering everything we found today.
resources.note: Answer the five questions it asks you. Short answers are fine. Then watch it build something shaped by your answers instead of its own guess.
